description: Repo-scale (cpp-eventbus): EventBus::bulkResubscribe must validate every subscription id exists BEFORE moving any of them (atomic), plus a destination topic capacity check
prompts: Add an optional `maxSubscribersPerTopic` constructor argument to EventBus (default -1, meaning unlimited), a `countSubscribersForTopic(topic)` helper, and `int EventBus::resubscribe(int oldId, const std::string& newTopic)` (moves an existing subscription to a different topic, rejecting if the target topic is at capacity). Then add `int EventBus::bulkResubscribe(const std::vector<int>& oldIds, const std::string& newTopic)`, moving a batch of existing subscriptions to `newTopic` in one call. This must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY id in `oldIds` currently exists BEFORE moving any of them - if one doesn't, return 0 and leave every subscription exactly where it was, not partially moved; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch into `newTopic` wouldn't push its subscriber count over maxSubscribersPerTopic, again before moving anything. Return 1 on success.
name: add_cpp_eventbus_bulk_resubscribe_atomic
